cases.expected: Returns a non‑null Message that is an instance of Update and whose question name equals the supplied zone (example.com.)
cases.description: Typical use case – a valid, fully‑qualified domain name is supplied. The factory should create an Update message ready for further manipulation.
The method must reject a null zone argument because a DNS update cannot be created without a target zone.

cases.expected: Returns a non‑null Message that is an instance of Update and whose question name equals the root name (".")
cases.description: Edge case – the root zone (".") is a valid DNS name. The factory should still produce a valid Update object.

cases.expected: Returns a non‑null Message that is an instance of Update and whose question name equals the long zone name
cases.description: Boundary test – the maximum length of a DNS name is 255 octets. This verifies that the factory accepts a name at the length limit without error.
A label longer than the DNS maximum of 63 octets is supplied. The Update constructor should reject the name and throw an IllegalArgumentException.
A wildcard name is supplied as the zone. DNS UPDATE messages cannot target a wildcard zone, so the factory must throw an IllegalArgumentException.
The name contains an empty label (two consecutive dots). This violates DNS name syntax and should cause the Update constructor to throw an IllegalArgumentException.
